description: 后对象 — 将军抓象，后王配合逼杀

intro.popup_en: The white queen is on e4 and Black's bishop is on e3. First use checks to drive the black king away, then capture the bishop.
intro.popup: ♛♗ <b>白后在e4，黑象在e3——先用将军驱开黑王，再吃掉黑象！

outro.popup_en: White wins by checking the king away, driving it into the corner, and coordinating the queen and king for checkmate.
outro.popup: ✅ 白方获胜！关键技巧：将军驱王、逼入死角、后王配合绝杀

moves.popup_en: The white queen checks along a square color the bishop cannot control.
moves.popup: ⚡ 白王沿着象的异色格子移动。

moves.popup_en: The black king has few choices.
The queen captures the bishop on e3.
The black king escapes toward the corner.
The white king joins actively and advances toward the center to support the queen.
moves.popup: 白王积极参战，向中心推进配合白后。

moves.popup_en: The white king approaches and restricts the black king's movement.
moves.popup: 白王逼近，限制黑王活动范围。

moves.popup_en: The white king reaches e8 and blocks the black king's route.
moves.popup: 白王到达e8，堵住黑王退路。

moves.popup_en: The queen blocks g8 and f8, driving the black king toward the corner.
moves.popup: ♛ 白后封锁g8和f8，黑王被赶向角落。

moves.popup_en: The black king is forced into the corner.
The white king continues to close the net while the queen maintains the blockade.
The queen closes in and delivers checkmate.
